alerts.title: Product alerts
alerts.description: Matching database prices or saleable stock trigger an in-app notice once per saved alert. Save the alert again to rearm it. Email and push also require the corresponding notification preferences; push requires a registered device.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Queue email only for active users who opted in to promotions. Counts reflect recorded provider acceptance, not inbox delivery.

coupons.title: Manage promo codes
coupons.description: Seller codes apply only to that seller’s products. Administrator codes apply to the whole order. Reservations count toward limits; cancellation releases a reservation and completed refunds keep the usage consumed.

offers.title: Available offers
offers.description: These are active offers configured by the platform or sellers. Seller offers apply to eligible items from that seller. Apply a code at checkout to check its actual discount. Reservations count toward usage limits; completed refunds do not restore a used offer.

delivery-kyc.title: Delivery partner verification
delivery-kyc.description: Submit your actual vehicle and license details for review. Approval and availability are recorded by the backend.

admin-tax-documents.title: Registered GST invoices
admin-tax-documents.description: Amounts are recorded from actual invoices issued by sellers. TrueHand does not generate tax rates or infer a filing position. Reconcile these records with the issued documents.

seller-tax-documents.title: Issued GST invoices
seller-tax-documents.description: Register an actual issued invoice for a paid order. Enter the amounts from that document and the GST registration on your saved business profile.

return-receipts.title: Physical return receipts
return-receipts.description: Record goods actually received. Restocked items increase inventory once. Damaged and quarantined items remain outside saleable stock.

notification-devices.title: Notification devices
notification-devices.description: Only devices registered to your account appear here. Revoking a device stops queued push jobs for it.

notification-dispatches.title: Notification delivery attempts
notification-dispatches.description: Provider accepted means the mail or push provider accepted a message. It does not confirm that you received or read it.

admin-notification-dispatches.title: Notification delivery queue
admin-notification-dispatches.description: Provider accepted means the mail or push provider accepted a message. It does not confirm that you received or read it.

subscription-purchases.title: Seller subscription purchases
subscription-purchases.description: Actual prepaid purchases. Refresh a payment to recover its provider status if the payment confirmation was interrupted. No automatic renewal.

product-editor.title: Edit product
product-editor.description: Changes to product content require moderation. Manage SKU quantities through product variants.
